start.title: Hidden in the Winepress
start.text:
Midianites raid the harvest.
You thresh wheat in secret, afraid.

choices.text: Curse the Lord for His silence
choices.feedback: He has not abandoned you.

choices.text: Quietly cry out to the Lord
choices.feedback: Judges 6:6 — The Israelites cried out to the Lord because of Midian.

choices.text: Flee with what little remains
choices.feedback: He is calling you to stay.

curse_consequence.title: He Still Hears
curse_consequence.text:
Bitterness will not feed Israel.
Turn your heart toward Him.

choices.text: Quietly cry out to the Lord
choices.feedback: Peace settles in you.

flee_consequence.title: He Calls You Back
flee_consequence.text:
Running cannot save your people.
Lift your eyes from the floor.

choices.text: Quietly cry out to the Lord
choices.feedback: You stop and listen.

angel_call.title: Mighty Warrior
angel_call.text:
"The Lord is with you, mighty one."
The words shake your trembling heart.

choices.text: Laugh and dismiss the angel
choices.feedback: Do not mock His messenger.

choices.text: Insist you are too weak
choices.feedback: His strength is your answer.

choices.text: Bow and accept His calling
choices.feedback: Judges 6:14 — The Lord turned to Gideon and said, "Go in the strength you have and save Israel out of Midian's hand. Am I not sending you?"

dismiss_consequence.title: The Fire Remains
dismiss_consequence.text:
His sign burns on the rock.
This call will not pass you by.

choices.text: Bow and accept His calling
choices.feedback: You bow your head low.

weak_consequence.title: His Power, Not Yours
weak_consequence.text:
He chose you because you are small.
Let Him be strong through you.

choices.text: Bow and accept His calling
choices.feedback: Your hands stop shaking.

fleece_test.title: A Sign on the Fleece
fleece_test.text:
Doubt still gnaws at your heart.
You lay the wool on the ground.

choices.text: Ask humbly for His confirmation
choices.feedback: Judges 6:36-37 — Gideon said to God, "If you will save Israel by my hand as you have promised—look, I will place a wool fleece on the threshing floor. If there is dew only on the fleece and all the ground is dry, then I will know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you said."

choices.text: Demand a sign as proof of power
choices.feedback: Ask, do not command.

choices.text: Ignore your doubts and march
choices.feedback: Faith and prayer must walk together.

demand_consequence.title: Ask in Reverence
demand_consequence.text:
He grants signs to the humble.
Kneel and ask, do not demand.

choices.text: Ask humbly for His confirmation
choices.feedback: Dew gathers on the fleece.

ignore_consequence.title: Bring Him Your Doubt
ignore_consequence.text:
He answers honest questions.
Lay your fear before Him.

choices.text: Ask humbly for His confirmation
choices.feedback: His sign comes with the morning.

army_reduction.title: The Spring of Harod
army_reduction.text:
"Your army is too many," He says.
Thirty-two thousand wait behind you.

choices.text: Refuse — you need every man
choices.feedback: His count is not your count.

choices.text: Send home the fearful and watchful
choices.feedback: Judges 7:3 — The Lord told Gideon to announce to the people, "Anyone who trembles with fear may turn back and leave Mount Gilead." So twenty-two thousand men left, while ten thousand remained.

choices.text: Hide some in the hills as backup
choices.feedback: He needs no hidden reserves.

refuse_consequence.title: He Saves By Few
refuse_consequence.text:
If you keep the many, you steal His glory.
Obey and trim the ranks.

choices.text: Send home the fearful and watchful
choices.feedback: The camp grows still and small.

hide_consequence.title: His Plan Is Enough
hide_consequence.text:
Trust the few He has chosen.
Hidden men reveal hidden fear.

choices.text: Send home the fearful and watchful
choices.feedback: Only three hundred remain.

night_attack.title: Three Hundred at Midnight
night_attack.text:
The Midianite camp sprawls below.
Torches in jars, trumpets in hand.

choices.text: Charge the camp in silent steel
choices.feedback: His way is not the sword first.

choices.text: Wait for daylight and reinforcements
choices.feedback: Now is the hour He gave.

choices.text: Break the jars and sound the trumpets
choices.feedback: Judges 7:20 — The three companies blew their trumpets and broke the jars. Grasping the torches in their left hands and blowing the trumpets in their right, they shouted, "A sword for the Lord and for Gideon!"

charge_consequence.title: His Plan, His Victory
charge_consequence.text:
Steel alone will not break them.
Obey the strange command.

choices.text: Break the jars and sound the trumpets
choices.feedback: You raise the clay jar high.

wait_consequence.title: The Hour Is Now
wait_consequence.text:
He has shaken them in their dreams.
Do not waste the night He gave.

choices.text: Break the jars and sound the trumpets
choices.feedback: You signal the three hundred.

victory.title: The Sword of the Lord
victory.text:
Midian turns sword on Midian.
The vast camp scatters into the dark.

choices.text: Give the glory to the Lord alone
choices.feedback: Judges 7:22 — The three hundred men blew their trumpets, and the Lord caused the men throughout the camp to turn on each other with their swords.

choices.text: Boast of your clever battle plan
choices.feedback: His arm broke them, not yours.

choices.text: Demand a crown from the people
choices.feedback: The Lord shall rule over you.

boast_consequence.title: Lift His Name
boast_consequence.text:
Three hundred could never have done this.
Give Him every word of praise.

choices.text: Give the glory to the Lord alone
choices.feedback: You bow as the camp burns.

crown_consequence.title: He Is the King
crown_consequence.text:
No throne belongs in your hand.
Return the glory to its Owner.

choices.text: Give the glory to the Lord alone
choices.feedback: You lay the crown back down.

ending_faithful.title: The Land Has Peace
ending_faithful.text:
Forty years of quiet will follow.
Fear became faith, weakness His power.
